create_ply_mesh_file: create a PLY file from vertex positions, colors, and face indices for 3D mesh visualization
create_cylinder_mesh_between_points: create a cylinder mesh with vertices and indices between two 3D points for rendering edges
generate_color_palette: generate a list of 41 RGB color tuples for visualizing different 3D bounding box classes
transform_bbox_center_to_minmax: transform 3D bounding boxes from center-size format to min-max corner format with optional gravity adjustment
write_bbox_as_ply: write 3D bounding boxes as a PLY file with colored cylinder edges for each box
